enabled.description: Enable inclusion of a registration certificate in credential issuer metadata.

mode.description: import: use an existing JWT, generate: create via registrar using attestation data derived from configured credential configurations.

jwt.description: Existing registration certificate JWT used when mode is import.

privacyPolicy.description: Privacy policy URL used when generating a registration certificate (optional if registrar defaults are configured).

supportUri.description: Support URI used when generating a registration certificate (optional if registrar defaults are configured).
